name: web-project-management-landing-sections-with-cyan-frame-and-feature-bento
title: Task-manager landing sections: three icon columns, a dashboard in a cyan frame, and a bento of feature cards
whatItIs: A white page with a 'Solutions' pill and 'Solve your team's biggest challenges', three columns with orange line icons and short copy, a large dashboard in a cyan rounded frame with a floating green check tile and a date tile, then a 'Features' section 'Keep everything in one place' with a bento of cards (collaboration, time management, task tracking, customisable workspaces) each with a UI fragment.
whatItMeans: Clear and friendly; a bright frame and UI fragments explain productivity features visually.
techniques: Frame the dashboard in a saturated cyan panel.
Float small sticker-like tiles beside it.
Show each feature as a UI fragment in a bento card.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured panel holding a product screenshot.
A card showing a cropped part of the interface.
A small sticker-like tile outside the frame.
